stage0230_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Sounds like you had it rough too, $$桂$$.」

stage0230_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$桂$$
「When I returned from $$ＡＤＷ$$, that spacequake
　didn't send me to this world. I made it back
　to the 《$$ファクトリー$$》 safely...」

stage0230_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$桂$$
「I thought I could go back to roaming around
　with Mimsy, free as the wind. Then I got caught
　in another spacequake. Just my luck.」

stage0230_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$n
（This man fought with $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ in $$ＵＣＷ$$,
　then joined $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$ in $$ＡＤＷ$$ too...）

stage0230_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$桂$$
「Well... Maybe it's the fate of a Singularity.」

stage0230_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$柿小路$$
「Ah... This is your first time meeting $$桂$$, $n.」

stage0230_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
Kei
「Then let me introduce myself.
　I'm $$桂木桂$$, a handsome young man,
　as you can see, and I pilot the $$オーガス$$.」

stage0230_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$モーム$$
「I'm $$モーム$$, Master $$桂$$'s personal assistant robot.
　It's a pleasure to meet you.」

stage0230_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I can't believe such an adorable girl is a robot...」

stage0230_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$'s right.
　If only a certain dimensional merchant
　were as cute as $$モーム$$.」

stage0230_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$モーム$$
「Thank you, Master $$ワッ太$$.
　I'm so happy to hear you say that.」

stage0230_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Hehe... I'm used to being called President,
　but Master still feels kind of embarrassing.」

stage0230_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$n
「So what did you mean by Singularity?」

stage0230_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$桂$$
「Simply put, I'm the reason the current
　multiverse came into being.」

stage0230_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$桂$$
「During an operation in another world,
　I activated something called a 《$$時空震動弾$$》.
　It caused the dimensional barriers to collapse...」

stage0230_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$桂$$
「The result was a multiverse where parallel worlds
　all mixed together.」

stage0230_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$n
「The $$時空震動弾$$...
　That was the root cause of everything...」

stage0230_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$桂$$
「When I activated it,
　my partner $$オルソン#50$$ and I were both there,
　and we became Singularities...」

stage0230_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$桂$$
「That made us the key to $$時空修復$$ in $$ＵＣＷ$$.」

stage0230_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Then can you repair spacetime
　and restore the world to how it was?!」

stage0230_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$桂$$
「If a Singularity, the will that began a spacequake,
　contacts the origin of the dimensions forming the
　multiverse, the Great Singularity, repair is possible...」

stage0230_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$桂$$
「But so many spacequakes have struck this multiverse,
　we no longer know where that origin is.」

stage0230_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$柿小路$$
「You're as carefree as ever, $$桂$$.」

stage0230_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$桂$$
「We have no choice but to accept what happened.」

stage0230_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$モーム$$
「That positive attitude is what makes you so great,
　Master $$桂$$!」

stage0230_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$桂$$
「Though I guess I've gotten used
　to this kind of situation...」

stage0230_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$桂$$
「For now, I'll keep hope alive in this world too.
　I dream of the day I return to my beloved Mimsy.」

stage0230_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$モーム$$
「Of course I'll help too, Master Kei!
　With daily life and even navigating the $$オーガス$$!」

stage0230_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$桂$$
「Well, I'll be in your care from now on.
　Should I start by saying hello to Director $$大塚$$?」

stage0230_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「I heard the Director went to $$アクエリア市$$.」

stage0230_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$柿小路$$
「It likely has something to do
　with that machine called Aquarion.」

stage0230_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$桂$$
（What's this strange feeling...?
　That was my first time seeing Aquarion,
　yet it somehow feels familiar...）

stage0230_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$桂$$
（But everyone from $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ and $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$
　says they've never seen it before...
　Is it just my imagination...?）

stage0230_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$大塚$$
「...Very well, Chairwoman $$クレア$$.
　As you proposed, the Far East Branch will take in
　Aquarion and the Elements.」

stage0230_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$クレア$$
「I intend to deploy Aquarion with the combination
　that is currently most stable:
　$$アマタ$$, $$カイエン$$, and $$ゼシカ$$.」

stage0230_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$クレア$$
「However, the Elements will be swapped as needed
　to suit battlefield conditions.」

stage0230_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$ミサト$$
「You mean Element Change via teleportation.」

stage0230_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$クレア$$
「$$ゲパルト$$'s crew are $$カイエン$$, $$アンディ$$, $$モロイ$$, and $$ミコノ$$.
　$$スパーダ$$'s are $$ゼシカ$$, $$ＭＩＸ$$, $$サザンカ$$, and $$シュレード$$...
　Switch them on the battlefield as needed.」

stage0230_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$クレア$$
「When you do, the Elements' mental condition
　will carry over from the previous pilots.」

stage0230_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Understood.
　For the time being, I, Lt. Col. Katsuragi,
　will oversee its operation.」

stage0230_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$クレア$$
「Also, when Aquarion uses certain weapons,
　the optimal Elements will be selected automatically.」

stage0230_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$城田$$
「I see...
　So there is no need to perform Element Change
　consciously.」

stage0230_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$クレア$$
「Correct.
　Changes made when using these weapons are temporary.
　Afterward, it will return to its prior state.」

stage0230_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$ミサト$$
「As expected of technology from another world...
　It's unlike any machine system we know.」

stage0230_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$クレア$$
「Furthermore, $$聖天使学園$$ has established
　a sister school partnership with Jindai High
　in Tokyo-2.」

stage0230_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$クレア$$
「When there are no deployments,
　the Elements will study a variety of subjects
　at Jindai High.」

stage0230_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$大塚$$
「Understood.
　We will make the necessary arrangements.」

stage0230_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$城田$$
「What is it, Supreme Commander $$不動$$?」

stage0230_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$不動$$
「How does one make this doughnut vanish?」

stage0230_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$城田$$
（Is this some sort of Zen riddle...?
　No, before that... Where did this man
　even get that doughnut...?）

stage0230_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$ミサト$$
（What is the point of this question...?
　Could our answer make them withdraw the offer
　to entrust Aquarion to us...?）

stage0230_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$大塚$$
「Wouldn't the doughnut be gone if you ate it?」

stage0230_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$不動$$
「Then all that remains is the void...」

stage0230_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$大塚$$
「That's rather dramatic.
　If you're still hungry, just buy another.」

stage0230_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$不動$$
「Director $$大塚$$, the Elements are in your care.
　May these youths enjoy a wholesome education.」

stage0230_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$大塚$$
「You need not worry about that.
　Our force has many young people
　around their age.」

stage0230_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$城田$$
「W-Well then, we will take our leave.」

stage0230_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$スオミ$$
「...But are you certain about this?
　You're placing the Elements in an environment
　where they will mingle with the opposite sex.」

stage0230_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$クレア$$
「That is also why we are assigning them to this force.」

stage0230_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$スオミ$$
「Why, Chairwoman?
　Didn't we fit the Elements with devices
　that shock them to prevent romance?」

stage0230_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$スオミ$$
「I heard you and the Chairwoman traveled the world
　to unravel Aquarion's mysteries. What connection
　does love have to Aquarion?」

stage0230_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$クレア$$
「Miss $$スオミ$$...
　You know the story of $$アポロン$$ and $$シルフィ$$, yes?」

stage0230_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$スオミ$$
「Y-Yes... Everyone knows that fairy tale.
　I believe they even made a movie about it.
　It was called $$アクエリアの舞う空$$...」

stage0230_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$クレア$$
「Yes... 12,000 years ago, after the battle
　with the $$堕天翅$$, the lovers $$アポロン$$
　and $$シルフィ$$ were torn apart.」

stage0230_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$クレア$$
「Feelings too intense can sometimes bring ruin...」

stage0230_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$クレア$$
「$$アポロン$$ and $$シルフィ$$'s longing for each other
　after being torn apart is what causes the revived
　Aquarion of our era to go berserk.」

stage0230_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$クレア$$
「That is why Neo-DEAVA sealed Aquarion's true power.
　...You know that all too well,
　don't you, Mr. $$ドナール$$?」

stage0230_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$ドナール$$
「Yes... More than I ever wanted to.」

stage0230_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$クレア$$
「It seems we cannot avoid fighting the Abductors
　in this world either.
　And our enemies are growing more powerful.」

stage0230_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$クレア$$
「To fight them,
　we have no choice but to rely on forbidden power.」

stage0230_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$クレア$$
「Aquarion syncs with the Elements' emotions
　across dimensions, amplifying its power in battle...
　The fiercer the emotions, the greater its strength.」

stage0230_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$クレア$$
「What is the fiercest, most passionate emotion
　a person can feel...? Do you know, Miss $$スオミ$$?」

stage0230_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$クレア$$
「But it must remain only a crush.
　If it ever develops into genuine romance,
　Aquarion will go berserk...」

stage0230_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$ドナール$$
（That was the tragedy of that Aquarion...
　The day I lost Nanao...）

stage0230_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$クレア$$
「But if they fight just shy of the forbidden step,
　right at the threshold where a crush becomes romance,
　Aquarion will wield tremendous power.」

stage0230_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$スオミ$$
「Then the power $$アマタ・ソラ$$ has shown until now...」

stage0230_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$クレア$$
「Likely came from his relationship with
　$$ミコノ・スズシロ$$, just short of romance.」

stage0230_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$不動$$
「We seek power just shy of running wild...
　This is love held at the brink!」

stage0230_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$クレア$$
「The Elements have lived in the closed world
　of $$聖天使学園$$. They will have many new
　experiences in the world beyond it.」

stage0230_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$ドナール$$
「But what if it develops into romance...?!」

stage0230_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$アルト$$
「...If the student council president summoned us,
　does this have something to do
　with the Volunteer Club's activities?」

stage0230_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$n
「I understand why $$アルト$$, our president, Chidori,
　our manager, and $$宗介$$, our security officer,
　are here, but do I need to be?」

stage0230_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$かなめ$$
「What are you talking about?
　$n... You're the vice president.」

stage0230_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Well... While you were all away on missions,
　the school pointed out that we hadn't chosen
　a vice president...」

stage0230_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$かなめ$$
「So there you have it.
　I chose based on my own judgment and bias.」

stage0230_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Sorry, sorry.
　But I did put plenty of thought into it.」

stage0230_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$アルト$$
「Give it up, $n.
　Taking on things like this is part
　of the volunteer spirit.」

stage0230_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$n
「...I guess I have no choice...
　I owe all of you, after all.」

stage0230_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$かなめ$$
「You all have it rough too...
　You fight across the world and in space, then come
　back and get sent everywhere as volunteers...」

stage0230_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$アルト$$
「That's what we get for naming the club this!」

stage0230_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$n
「Calm down, $$アルト$$.
　Is your volunteer spirit as president a sham?」

stage0230_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$宗介$$
「That is enough.
　His Excellency the President has arrived.」

stage0230_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$林水$$
「Everyone assembled ahead of time.
　You are clearly well trained.」

stage0230_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$かなめ$$
（These two get along strangely well...）

stage0230_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$n
（If he is on $$宗介$$'s wavelength,
　then that president isn't normal either.）

stage0230_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$林水$$
「I read Miss $$スズネ$$'s report
　on the Volunteer Club's accomplishments.」

stage0230_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$かなめ$$
「What...? But wasn't that report for the school...?」

stage0230_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$林水$$
「Students are a vital part of this school.
　I believe the student council that governs them
　naturally has the right to examine such reports.」

stage0230_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$かなめ$$
「So you got the report
　through some shady means...」

stage0230_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$林水$$
「I merely exercised a legitimate right.」

stage0230_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$n
（It would be dangerous to defy him carelessly...）

stage0230_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$宗介$$
「So, Your Excellency...
　Does your summons mean
　we have a new mission?」

stage0230_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$林水$$
「Correct.
　Mr. $$大貫$$, the caretaker, has requested
　assistance cleaning the school.」

stage0230_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$林水$$
「Though he has gained a young helper in Mr. Nagare,
　it appears he still cannot attend
　to the entire school.」

stage0230_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$かなめ$$
「And you want the Volunteer Club to help?」

stage0230_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$林水$$
「Compelling you to accept would violate
　the spirit of volunteerism.
　You must decide for yourselves whether to accept.」

stage0230_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$かなめ$$
「$$アルト$$, we have no choice but to accept.」

stage0230_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$n
（Read the room, $$アルト$$.
　This is the student council president's trap.）

stage0230_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$かなめ$$
（If we refuse here,
　he'll saddle us with an even harder problem.）

stage0230_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$林水$$
「Well then, Saotome...
　May I take it that you accept the request?」

stage0230_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$アルト$$
「Yes!
　The Volunteer Club pledges to serve
　our school and society in the spirit of service!」

stage0230_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$林水$$
「Understood.
　Ask Mr. $$大貫$$ for the details.」

stage0230_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$かなめ$$
（Aww... So much for our long awaited day off...）

stage0230_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$アルト$$
（Then we'll finish as fast as we can.
　I'll make $$カミーユ$$, $$葵$$, and the others help too.）

stage0230_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$かなめ$$
「President, we'd very much like to help Mr. $$大貫$$,
　but our members are tired from all their activities
　both in and outside school.」

stage0230_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$かなめ$$
「So, regrettable though it is,
　we will have to take this time to rest.」

stage0230_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$林水$$
「Then it cannot be helped.
　Well... Mr. Nagare should do the work
　of about ten people.」

stage0230_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Yes!
　I'm sure he can handle it!」

stage0230_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I'm the manager.
　Looking after everyone's health is part of my job.」

stage0230_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Everyone, enjoy your first day off in ages.」

stage0230_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$宗介$$
「The timing is convenient.
　$$風間$$ invited me to an event.」

stage0230_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$宗介$$
「It is quite interesting.
　You should all come with me.」

stage0230_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I'm getting a bad feeling about this...」

stage0230_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, well. It seems $n and the others
　will be volunteering under the direction
　of Mr. $$大貫$$, the caretaker.」

stage0230_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As for this Mr. $$大貫$$...
　By my estimation...」

stage0230_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Too bad! We're out of time!
　A stranger to the spirit of service,
　I'll work hard today too... business, business!」

stage0230_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, well. It seems $n and the others
　will be heading out with $$宗介$$ as their guide.」

stage0230_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Goodness. I must agree with $$かなめ$$,
　this leaves me deeply worried...」

stage0230_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, I suppose it's only to be expected.
　Now then, I'll work hard today too...
　business, business!」
